reports.title: Cerebras Systems Delivers Record Revenue in Third Quarter 2026,

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Financial Outlook
section: ◦Core gross margin in the range of 47% - 49%
◦Core operating margins in the range of (1%) to 1%

desk.headline: Core revenue up 70% to a record $230.9m, beat; full-year 2026 outlook raised to $940–960m

other.label: Core cloud and other services revenue

results: GAAP revenue rose 55% to $210.8m; core revenue (adding back customer-warrant costs and removing pass-through data-centre revenue) rose 70% to $230.9m, above the company's $214–216m guidance.
The business is shifting to renting out its chips: cloud and services revenue more than tripled to $141.9m while hardware sales fell 29% to $68.9m.
GAAP net loss widened to $161.2m ($0.67 a share) mainly on $155m of share-based pay; on its core measure Cerebras made a $29.8m profit.
Core operating margin was -14.3%, much better than the -25% to -23% guided; GAAP operating margin was -106%.
Cash and investments of $7.8bn after the IPO; contracted future revenue (RPO) stands at $26.1bn and 700MW of data-centre capacity is secured for delivery by end-2027.

guidance.summary: Cerebras raised its full-year 2026 core outlook: revenue $940–960m (was $880–890m), gross margin 42–44% (was 41–43%) and operating margin -10% to -8% (was -19% to -17%). It expects Q4 core revenue of $310–330m at roughly break-even operating margin, and the CEO said it expects to triple revenue in 2027.

points: CEO Andrew Feldman confirmed the new top-three hyperscaler cloud deal is with Microsoft; terms and revenue timing will be shared next year.
Demand is running ahead of capacity: Cerebras said it could not yet support a broad rollout of OpenAI's fastest service tier.
The sales pipeline for fast AI inference grew more than tenfold in the quarter, according to the CFO.
The $26.1bn order book relies heavily on the OpenAI agreement, keeping customer concentration in focus.
Feldman framed the market as one of 'rapid change and compute shortages'.
call.source: Call coverage: Traders Agency, 13 Nov 2026, plus CEO/CFO remarks in the press release

watch: Delivery of the Q4 jump to $310–330m core revenue and the move to break-even core operating margin.
Details and timing of the Microsoft deal and progress on diversifying away from OpenAI.
Speed of data-centre and manufacturing ramp-ups, and the gap between GAAP losses and core profit.
